name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+1

- Play on TV: watch on your LG TV with the phone as the remote
  - The player on your phone becomes the remote: play/pause, the seek bar, skip buttons, skip intro, audio and subtitle pickers and next episode all act on the TV.
  - Your progress is kept as usual (AniList, Simkl, Stremio, resume point), and the next episode starts on the TV by itself.
  - Works for anime and Movies & TV. Streams that need special headers and downloaded files are passed through the phone.
  - Subtitle files (SRT, ASS, VTT) are drawn by the TV app. ASS styling is dropped for now; the lines and timing are kept.
  - If the phone locks, the TV keeps playing and picks the link back up.
  - "Play here" brings the video back to the phone at the TV's spot.
  - TV report: the wrong "mkv=no" line is replaced by what actually played.
